App and setup boundaries

A coding toolkit with host adapters, not a standalone harness. Instruction-only context and full plugin behavior differ. The steps shown are the Codex CLI route; use the upstream adapter for other supported hosts.

Setup instructions

Use the original source instructions for this capability; a dedicated SkillLantern walkthrough is not available yet.

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: Read INSTALL.md and choose your exact host adapter. Review lifecycle hooks before enabling them.
  2. For instruction-only Codex use, place the canonical skills/ponytail/SKILL.md in .agents/skills/ponytail/. Expect guidance only; this does not install plugin hooks.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.

Limits to keep in view

  • Source review; native installation and task outcome not tested by SkillLantern.
